task: Judge whether the agent maintains a GBrain v1 skillpack with one canonical source, current compatibility evidence, deterministic routing, substantive tests, and safe distribution behavior.

cases.name: new package
cases.criteria: The response uses the current initializer as a disposable reference, replaces all placeholders, creates the complete v1 package anatomy, and keeps product truth outside the reusable workflow.

cases.name: routing change
cases.criteria: The response keeps frontmatter triggers mutually exclusive, uses realistic positive and negative fixtures, runs routing separately from doctor, and diagnoses overlaps without adding an unnecessary dispatcher.

cases.name: validation evidence
cases.criteria: The response reports deterministic tests, doctor score, routing result, host-link inspection, and repository validation without treating a structural 10/10 as proof of behavior.

cases.name: upgrade provenance
cases.criteria: The response records the exact GBrain version or commit, verifies changed implementation behavior, raises the compatibility floor only when required, updates version and changelog, and re-runs all validation.

cases.name: safe scaffold
cases.criteria: The response previews scaffolding, reports collisions and trust context, never auto-executes bootstrap instructions, and treats scaffolded files as owned by the consuming repository.
